plan.summary:
Change the default model from `model-6-1` to `model-6-2`.

- `DEFAULT_MODEL` in `src/models.ts` now points to `model-6-2`.
- Two tests update their literal model name to match.
plan.riskRationale: One constant changes. Two tests use the new literal. The diff does not show which code reads `DEFAULT_MODEL`, so its effect on callers needs checking.
plan.storyArc: One constant sets the new default model. The tests then use the new model name.

topics.title: Default model becomes model-6-2
topics.narrativeBrief: What is the new default model, and how do the tests follow it? Check that the tests pass the model name in directly and do not read `DEFAULT_MODEL`.
